page.overview:
Who is Ferris?

, more commonly known as Flimsy, is a shapeshifter sorcerer who joined the Darrington Brigade for their job performing security for the maiden voyage of the skyship "Hubris". He was played by Matthew Mercer.

Flimsy was a young, pale, gaunt man with long stringy black hair. His eyes were completely black saucers. When the Darrington Brigade met him, he was wearing a loose fitting tunic and a massive backpack covered with all sorts of things, including a wooden sword.

Flimsy was incredibly timid and unsure of himself, but when in Taryon Darrington's form, was able to pull off his swagger and self-confidence.

Flimsy's hometown was the beautiful Menagerie Coast town of Feolinn. He had been studiously applying to join the Darrington Brigade for some time (with application forms he had made himself), and had to pay his own way to join them in Rexxentrum before they left for their security detail aboard the Hubris.
